compatibility_matrix.evidence: One persistent context per engine is compatible, but current PersistentContext.run sets shapes/addresses and synchronizes per call.
Fresh output tensors are allocated for every run; graph replay requires fixed output addresses.
KV cache length advances each step; a bounded multi-step graph can encode fixed lengths 8..15.
Fixed-address step outputs can become next-step inputs inside one captured window; arbitrary continuation requires recapture or memory redesign.
Static token-id and output addresses support capture for forced tokens.
TensorRT execute_async_v3 on the capture stream can be captured after warmup.
CPU NumPy argmax is outside CUDA Graph; benchmark uses forced tokens.
